notes_for_editor: Mostly rests on Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted, paraphrased) plus register text and Marine reports. Fiscal-year labels of the 1908/1911/1912 report volumes not independently confirmed; the Cottage City date 26 Jan 1911 is Lighthouse Friends' year, the reports give only the day. Footnote 7 title for the 1916-17 volume is approximate. Marine report pages matched from corpus page index. Current staffing not confirmed from a Coast Guard source; Wikipedia lead on a shore oceanographic programme not used. Quote of 1913 fog signal etc. rests on a single source. Tower height: Lighthouse Friends says 42 ft, register says 12 m (40 ft); both stated in the story.
